properties.digitized_from: Drawn by Pier & Point, not a hand trace: one of the leftover pieces of open ground between DataSF's official street centerlines and neighbouring mapped shapes in this area (about 11,626 sq m before shaping), chosen by hand from a numbered map of those pieces, idealized to a proper rectangle sharing Third Street Garage's own west edge and orientation, with the north walkway strip (a narrow pinch point, width dropping to ~2m) cut off.
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-20: the owner corrected the prior resolution (block_inventory 23A had pointed at Genentech Hall). The owner directly identified the real building here as UCSF Neurosurgery at San Francisco Mission Bay, west of and adjacent to Third Street Garage. Construction: took real-gap-fragment 2, cut off its north walkway strip at the point the fragment's cross-sectional width pinches to ~2m (lat 37.76878), excluded the portion overlapping/east of Third Street Garage's own real footprint, then idealized the remainder into a proper rectangle aligned with Third Street Garage's own minimum-rotated-rectangle orientation (sharing its exact west edge as the shared border) per the owner's direct instruction. Result: 8,027 sqm. RENAMED 2026-09-22: cross-checking UCSF's own June 2025 CAC presentation (map updated December 2024) showed this block's official UCSF-map name is 'Weill Neurosciences Building (23A)'. The owner clarified UCSF Neurosurgery is a clinical department practicing in the building, not the building's own name -- the building may house other departments too. Renamed accordingly; geometry and position unchanged (this record was already correctly positioned west of Third Street Garage, matching 23A). 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: the building name and block (23A) are now cited to UCSF Health's Weill Neurosciences Building page (1651 4th Street) and a CEQAnet notice (SCH 2013092047) that calls it 'the planned Weill Neurosciences Building (Block 23A)'; UCSF Neurosurgery's presence is corroborated by UCSF Health's 'Neurosurgery Mission Bay - Fourth St.' location page at the same address. The June 2025 UCSF CAC deck cited earlier names neither the block nor the building in its text. The three URLs were added to source_doc_urls. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, digitized_from reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'APPROXIMATE -- an idealized rectangle (owner-directed construction: real-gap-fragment shape cut and aligned to Third Street Garage's own real orientation), not a hand-traced or surveyed footprint. The building name (Weill Neurosciences Building) is confirmed by UCSF's own campus map; UCSF Neurosurgery's presence in it, first the owner's direct knowledge, is corroborated by UCSF Health's own 'Neurosurgery Mission Bay - Fourth St.' location page, which gives 1651 4th Street, the same address as UCSF Health's Weill Neurosciences Building page.'; digitized_from: 'Owner-directed construction, not a hand trace: real-gap-fragment 2 (11,626 sqm raw, from the numbered real-gap-fragment map for this area), idealized to a proper rectangle sharing Third Street Garage's own minimum-rotated-rectangle west edge and orientation, with the north walkway strip (a real gap fragment pinch point, width dropping to ~2m) cut off.'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- an idealized rectangle (drawn by Pier & Point from the leftover open ground between official street lines and neighbouring mapped shapes, cut and aligned to Third Street Garage's own real orientation), not a hand-traced or surveyed footprint. The building name (Weill Neurosciences Building) is confirmed by UCSF's own campus map; UCSF Neurosurgery's presence in it, first based on Pier & Point's own knowledge, is corroborated by UCSF Health's own 'Neurosurgery Mission Bay - Fourth St.' location page, which gives 1651 4th Street, the same address as UCSF Health's Weill Neurosciences Building page.
properties.notes: OCII plan block 23A on UCSF's own campus map; a CEQAnet notice of determination (SCH 2013092047, Aug 4, 2017) calls it 'the planned Weill Neurosciences Building (Block 23A)'. Previously mismapped to Genentech Hall (a different, separate building further west); Genentech Hall's own real plan-block correlation is now an open question pending future review. UCSF Health lists 'Neurosurgery Mission Bay - Fourth St.' at 1651 4th Street, the address of the Weill Neurosciences Building, so UCSF Neurosurgery practices in this building; the building may house other departments as well.
